contract: write a .env at contract time and delete it afterwards
run an entry module that calls dotenv.config() after statically importing a module that reads process.env at import time
assert that import-time capture is undefined, because ESM evaluates the whole import graph before the body runs
assert process.env holds the value after config() returns, proving the .env parsed and only the ordering was wrong
assert the capture is the correct value when 'dotenv/config' is the first import
assert the capture is the correct value when the env-reading module is pulled in by a dynamic import after config()
case.goal: process.env is undefined in an ESM module even though dotenv.config() ran and .env exists
